item.title: Missouri House narrowly passes bill to regulate gray-market slot machines
item.description: (Missouri Independent) – Legislation creating a state-run video lottery system to replace and regulate “gray market” slot machines that have proliferated for years in gas stations, bars, and fraternal halls across the state narrowly cleared the Missouri House Wednesday, winning passage by just one vote.
